content: {"paper_id":"W2135076825","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"semi-supervised-learning","exact_quote":"We propose a semi-supervised framework for kernel mean shift clustering (SKMS) that uses only pairwise constraints to guide the clustering procedure.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"论文提出半监督核均值漂移聚类框架，仅用成对约束指导聚类，属于以有限监督信息结合未标注样本的半监督学习设定。"},{"keyword_id":"weakly-supervised-learning","exact_quote":"uses only pairwise constraints to guide the clustering procedure","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"只使用成对约束而非完整实例级聚类标签，监督信号不完整，且该弱监督条件是核心研究问题。"},{"keyword_id":"graph-structure-learning","exact_quote":"This is achieved by modifying the initial kernel matrix by minimizing a log det divergence-based objective function.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"通过最小化目标函数修改初始核矩阵，即学习/修正样本间相似度或亲和矩阵以融入约束。"}],"abstentions":[],"input_issues":[]}
